products.name: Green Fluorite
products.title: Green Fluorite
products.subtitle: A natural stone for scent, space and reflection.
products.description: Natural Green Fluorite selected as a tactile object for scent rituals, quiet spaces and personal reflection.
products.shortDescription: A natural Green Fluorite stone for scent rituals and quiet spaces.

howToUse: Place the stone in a quiet space.
Add a few drops of essential oil to the surface.
Allow the scent to diffuse naturally.
Use the moment as an invitation to pause and reflect.
ritual.note: Natural stones vary in colour, shape and texture. Each piece is unique.

story.headline: A stone for the space between scent and stillness.
story.body: Green Fluorite brings together stone, scent and ritual in one simple object. Use it as a quiet sensory anchor while reading, meditating, journaling or simply slowing down.

products.name: Incense Ceramic Holder
products.title: Incense Ceramic Holder
products.subtitle: A simple ceramic object for smoke ritual and quiet spaces.
products.description: A ceramic incense holder selected as an object for smoke rituals, meditation and quiet everyday spaces.
products.shortDescription: A ceramic incense holder for smoke ritual and quiet spaces.

howToUse: Place the holder on a stable heat-resistant surface.
Place an incense stick into the holder.
Light the incense and allow the smoke to fill the space.
Use the moment as a pause before beginning your practice.
ritual.note: For incense use only. Always use on a stable, heat-resistant surface.

story.headline: A vessel for the moment smoke enters the room.
story.body: A simple ceramic form selected for incense rituals, quiet spaces and moments of pause.
